تحتوشي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوِشِي (taḥtawišī) /taħ.ta.wi.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# تُحْتَوَشِي (tuḥtawašī) /tuħ.ta.wa.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
